en: Black‑and‑white image showing a cobblestone approach to a large arched gate in a worn Baroque or Renaissance‑style building. Above the rusticated stone arch is an elaborate coat of arms flanked by two lions and crowned with multiple coronets and plumes. Paint is peeling from the facade, revealing age and damage. A uniformed guard with a pickelhaube‑style spiked helmet stands in front of the archway with a dog at his side; other figures are visible in the shaded passage beyond. Iron railings line both sides of the approach.
